name: u7pro
command: ip link add br0 type dummy; ip link set br0 address 00:27:22:e0:00:22; ip addr add 192.0.2.22/24 dev br0; ip link set br0 up; cp /etc/resolv.conf /firmware/etc/resolv.conf; cp /etc/hosts /firmware/etc/hosts; mkdir -p /firmware/tmp /firmware/etc/persistent/cfg /firmware/var/run; cp /usr/bin/qemu-arm-static /firmware/tmp/qemu-arm-static; exec chroot /firmware /tmp/qemu-arm-static -B 0x100000000 /usr/bin/mcad
